name: Database Migration
description: Inspect the schema and migration framework, add a non-destructive migration unless permitted otherwise, and run it.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the current schema and an existing migration.
Find the migration framework and schema files.
Add the migration in the framework's format.
Run the project's migration command and report its output.
Create a new migration file when the framework requires one.
Run database tests when the project has them.

validation.rule: The existing migration framework was read, no destructive schema change ran without permission, and the migration command's result was reported.
